type A = { a: number };
type B = { b: number };
type Tagged = (() => number) & { tag: string };

function objectAsFunction(x: (A & B) | number) {
  if (typeof x === 'function') {
    const n: never = x;
    return n;
  }
  return 0;
}
function functionAsObject(x: Tagged | number) {
  if (typeof x === 'object') {
    const n: never = x;
    return n;
  }
  return 0;
}
function genericAsFunction<T>(x: T & A) {
  if (typeof x === 'function') return x.a;
  return 0;
}
function keptGeneric<T>(x: T & A) {
  if (typeof x === 'object') {
    const n: never = x;
    return n;
  }
  return 0;
}
function nullableIntersection(x: (A & B) | null | string) {
  if (typeof x === 'object') return x.a;
  return 0;
}
